# GENERIC PLACEHOLDERS. These are rounded generic values of the kind published in public generic databases

# Sources named below (each row's source column says which one
column2: and how the value was taken from it):

column1: #   ICE      = Inventory of Carbon and Energy (ICE) database v3.0 (Circular Ecology
#   ICE/m3   = an ICE v3.0 concrete value published per m3 (as republished by Climatiq
#              divided by 2400 kg/m3 here; ICE's own per-kg value can differ in the third decimal place
#   CIDB     = CIDB Malaysia "Embodied carbon inventory data for construction materials" (2021)
#              which reproduces the ICE v3.0 concrete values to 2 decimal places
#   IStructE = IStructE "How to calculate embodied carbon" 1st edition (2020) Table 2.3
#              The 2nd edition (2022) tables were not checked
#   RICS     = RICS "Whole life carbon assessment for the built environment"
#              Table 17 default transport scenarios for UK projects
#   DESNZ    = UK Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting 2025

column2: direct (not well-to-tank). A 2026 set was published in June 2026 and was not checked
